mapper.select: SELECT AS trend_date, SUM(CASE WHEN dr.transfer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dr.transfer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undelivered_count FROM t_transfer_object o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT transfer_id FROM t_transfer_delivery_record WHERE execute_status = 'SUCCESS' ) dr ON o.transfer_id = dr.transfer_id WHERE o.received_at >= #{startInclusive} AND o.received_at < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY ORDER BY trend_date
